newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Oct-Dec commercial land prices fall qtr/qtr.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Oct-Dec commercial land prices fall qtr/qtr.

text.p: Commercial land prices in the greater Tokyo area fell a preliminary 3.2 percent in the October to December quarter compared with the previous quarter, a government-affiliated research body said on Wednesday.
The Land Institute of Japan said commercial prices in central Tokyo fell 3.6 percent in the same period, while residential areas in greater Tokyo slipped 0.9 percent.
A National Land Agency official said residential prices were expected to remain mainly flat and the pace of declines in commercial land was expected to slow for "good properties".
The official added, however, that prices for unattractive commercial properties were expected to continue falling.
